verdict.rationale: Orrick's software-facing offerings (Tech Studio web tools, Orrick Labs legal tech, Orrick Connect portals) are legal-tech products, so a self-hosting question is a fair one to ask. However, nothing in the evidence documents a self-hostable deployment. The Tech Studio 'our version of open source' line is a metaphor for free, no-registration access to forms and articles, not deployable software. The interactive forms run on orrick.com and require cookies to load.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
